notes.note: Scoped review of the reference dependency delta: the historical flag and dual-store observations remain historical; the current Session API successor now explains shared detail transport. No dispatch, provider, or persistence claim changed. Follow-up review fixes: the list reader now uses getJson with real requestScope dispatch/body enforcement and its existing progress deadline; the broad authority subtree registers only the query client, never a new network stream; lifecycle facts include started/configured/state-changed/deleted; failed reads keep a sixty-second recovery interval even with healthy SSE. Production and consumer tests cover all four boundaries. The browser after/before counts are local deterministic-fixture observations, not a native or hosted release receipt. Additional first-send acceptance review: the SDK query factory owns the optional authority-scoped session key; the existing accepted-send reader uses that same factory with its captured scope. Draft and first-send-refusal acceptance are exercised against a real scoped QueryClient, with a foreign-authority Draft control. No send admission, transport receipt or provider-execution claim changed.
